description:
Event logs on one chain, filtered by address and/or topics over a block range. Tier 2 emits each log as { contract, event, args }, dropping logsBloom and per-log block duplication; an undecodable one stays raw as { address, topics, data, _event_unknown }. Check tier_degraded before reading `event` or `args`.
With both bounds concrete block NUMBERS (toBlock may be omitted/"latest") the range is walked in ascending chunks, stopping once the display cap fills: the reply says `range_fully_scanned: false`, carries a cursor, and `note` says why. `more_available` means more logs were seen than shown; `full_count` appears only when the whole range was scanned. Any other bound is ONE unbounded eth_getLogs: no chunking, no cursor, liable to tier 0.
Sui: Move events over a CHECKPOINT range. fromBlock is required; `address` is the emitting package[::module]; eventType and sender narrow it; `topics` is refused, not ignored. Same body; rows add checkpoint/digest/index.

chain.description: Chain slug as in rpc.ankr.com/<chain> — any chain Ankr serves (see listChains)

fromBlock.description: From block: decimal, 0x-hex, or tag (default latest)

maxLogs.description: Max logs to DISPLAY (default 50, max 1000). The scan stops once this is filled, so it also bounds how much is fetched upstream.

sender.description: Sui: the emitting transaction's sender, 0x + 64 hex

toBlock.description: To block: decimal, 0x-hex, or tag (default latest)

topics.description: Topic filters (0x + 64 hex, or null to wildcard); topics[0] is the event signature hash. Max 4 slots.

name: getLogs
title: Event logs
